2,998 likes, 110 comments - dr.rishabh2970 on September 15, 2026: "INI-CET ≠ NEET PG! 🔥

If you’re preparing for INI-CET, don’t follow the exact same strategy you used for NEET PG.

Some subjects carry relatively higher importance in INI-CET — especially Anatomy and Forensic Medicine.

8 subjects you NEED to make strong:

1. Anatomy 🦴
2. Biochemistry 🧬
3. Pathology 🔬
4. Pharmacology 💊
5. Microbiology 🦠
6. Surgery 🔪
7. Obstetrics & Gynaecology 👶
8. Forensic Medicine ⚖️

Get these 8 subjects rock solid, and you’ll have a strong foundation for a great INI-CET rank.

Don’t prepare harder. Prepare strategically.

Save this reel & start strengthening these 8 subjects today.".

4,025 likes, 13 comments - dr.rishabh2970 on July 9, 2025: "Last 1 month remaining for NEET PG. Here are some stats that you should remember. 
- top 9 subjects with maximum weightage of questions in NEET PG are Biochem, Micro, pharma, path, OBG, Medicine, Surgery and FMT as a minor. 
- these constitute 140-150 questions. Make them strong. You should not get more than 3 questions wrong in these subjects.".

20K likes, 79 comments - dr.nachiketbhatia on October 4, 2024: "Most in-demand medical specialties

Dr. Rishabh Jain shares that certain medical branches will have significant demand in the future.

He mentioned:

- Nuclear medicine will be in high demand due to the rise in cancer hospitals and a shortage of professionals.
- Gastroenterology will offer extensive opportunities, including subspecialties and surgery.
- Dermatology has potential but faces increased competition from cosmetic aesthetics.

For more, watch the full video on ‘The Nachiket Bhatia Show.’ Link in bio!".
